description: Source code for the NXP MCUX display driver for the Zephyr RTOS, implementing display interface functions, framebuffer management, and hardware initialization.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the display framebuffer, handling full and partial updates.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and supported pixel formats.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_get_framebuffer
methods.description: Returns the current active framebuffer pointer.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format for the display.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for display frame completion.

methods.name: mcux_dcnano_lcdif_init
methods.description: Initializes the display device, configures hardware, and prepares framebuffers.
